POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, MARCH 10, 2025
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM
Sarah Bedy, Member  Doug Killion, Member
Pam Chotiswatdi, Member  Julie Lie, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Sarah Bedy, called the meeting to order at 2:05 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

Roll call taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54532  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee meeting of
  Monday, February 10, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • Member Patricia Scott joined the meeting in person.

2.  25-54536  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the draft 2025 Homeless
  Services Advisory Committee (HSAC) Policy recommendations to the Mayor and
  City Council.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Page 1 of 4
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, MARCH 10, 2025
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • The subcommittee discussed statistics being updated once the PIT count
  numbers are made available. Committee members have
  requested transparency concerning shelter beds and occupancy. They would
  like an improved system for tracking shelter bed data, which could potentially
  be included in the 2025-2026 Policy recommendations under item number 2.
  Members are concerned about the type of shelter beds versus how many
  shelter beds are available.
  • Member Killion is concerned about the limitations of what the City and HSB
  staff can do regarding the recommendations related to shelter beds. He has
  requested that members provide a presentation to the committee on the
  shelter bed data.
  • The subcommittee members discussed the chain of authority process for
  policy recommendations put forward by the policy subcommittee. Members
  recommended being more specific on data that they would like to receive,
  this is specific to city council providing elected official oversight on the
  process of the recommendations.
  • The subcommittee members reviewed the 2025-2026 draft policy
  recommendations, went over the five recommendations, and discussed
  further information they would like to incorporate.
  • The committee discussed including the Tiny Homes Project in
  recommendation number four as a potential emergency shelter or cooling
  station.
  • Chair Sarah Bedy requested feedback from Bureau Manager Paul
  Duncan on the pilot budget for recommendation number five.

3.  25-54534  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the draft policies and
  procedures related to the powers of authority granted to the Homeless Services
  Advisory Committee by the Mayor and City Council.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Page 2 of 4
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, MARCH 10, 2025
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

  • Member Doug Killion discussed the Policies and Procedures of Authority
  handout that was provided. Member Killion provided the subcommittee
  background information on the chain of authority as stated in the handout.
  • Members discussed that HSAC meetings would serve as a "receive and file"
  discussion, as outlined in the agenda. The presentations provided by Bureau
  Manager Paul Duncan is for informational purposes and based on an open
  discussion between members and staff.
  • The subcommittee members discussed the recommendations presented at
  HSAC meetings and expressed a desire for a more efficient way to
  communicate information. Member Killion believes that recommendations
  shared at HSAC meetings should be formalized to determine whether they
  should be forwarded to the policy subcommittee for further discussion and
  inclusion in the annual recommendations.
  • The subcommittee will further discuss the policy recommendation process as
  a separate agenda item during the HSAC meeting to ensure everyone is on
  the same page.

4.  25-54533  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • Upcoming agenda items will consist of topics to be continued for discussion
  at the next meeting in April.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • No public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  • No announcements.
